nodes.description: Owner address stored in Ownable; gates all onlyOwner administrative functions.
Immutable Uniswap V2 router used for token swaps and liquidity addition.
Immutable Uniswap V2 pair address created in the constructor.
Constant burn address 0xdead used as liquidity recipient and burn sink.
Guard flag set true while swapBack runs to prevent nested swaps.
Marketing wallet that receives residual ETH from swapBack.
Charity wallet that receives the dev/charity ETH share from swapBack.
Maximum allowed buy/sell transaction size while limits are active.
Contract token balance threshold that triggers swapBack.
Maximum token balance allowed per wallet while limits are active.
Basis points of LP tokens automatically burned per cycle.
Flag enabling automatic LP burn during transfers.
Minimum seconds required between automatic LP burns.
Timestamp of the last automatic LP burn.
Cooldown period for manual LP burn.
Timestamp of the last manual LP burn.
Flag controlling whether max transaction and max wallet limits apply.
Flag that must be true before non-excluded transfers are allowed.
Flag enabling the swapBack routine during transfers.
Flag enabling the one-transfer-per-block anti-bot delay.
Mapping keyed by tx.origin storing last transfer block for anti-bot delay.
Mapping marking AMM pair addresses used for fee accounting.
Mapping of addresses excluded from fee taking.
Mapping of addresses excluded from max transaction/wallet limits.
ERC20 total supply of the token.
Constructor: configures router/pair, fees, exclusions, wallets and mints total supply.
onlyOwner: enables trading and swaps and records block.timestamp as lastLpBurnTime.
onlyOwner: permanently disables transaction and wallet limits.
onlyOwner: permanently disables the anti-bot transfer delay.
onlyOwner: updates the swap threshold with bounds checks against totalSupply.
onlyOwner: updates maxTransactionAmount with a lower-bound check.
onlyOwner: updates maxWallet with a lower-bound check.
onlyOwner: toggles an address exemption from max transaction/wallet limits.
onlyOwner: enables or disables automatic swapBack.
onlyOwner: sets buy fee components and requires total buy fees <= 20.
onlyOwner: sets sell fee components and requires total sell fees <= 25.
onlyOwner: toggles an address exemption from fee taking.
onlyOwner: registers an AMM pair, forbidding removal of the main pair.
Private helper that writes the automatedMarketMakerPairs mapping and emits an event.
onlyOwner: replaces the marketing wallet address.
onlyOwner: replaces the charity wallet address.
View function returning the fee-exemption status of an account.
Overridden _transfer implementing limits, anti-bot delay, fee taking, swapBack and LP burn triggers.
Private: approves and swaps contract tokens for ETH through the router with a block.timestamp deadline.
Private: approves tokens and adds ETH/token liquidity via the router to the dead address.
Private: swaps accumulated tokens, splits ETH and sends funds to charity and marketing wallets via low-level call.
onlyOwner: configures LP burn frequency, percent and enable flag with bounds checks.
Internal: burns a percentage of LP pair tokens to 0xdead and syncs the pair.
onlyOwner: manually burns LP pair tokens up to 10% after a cooldown and syncs the pair.
block.timestamp used as deadline, cooldown and LP burn scheduling value.
tx.origin used as the key of the anti-bot transfer delay mapping.
Low-level .call{value: ethForDev} to charityWallet with success flag ignored.
Low-level .call{value: address(this).balance} to marketingWallet with success flag ignored.
External router call swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with zero slippage tolerance.
External router call addLiquidityETH with zero minimum amounts.
External pair.sync() call inside the automatic LP burn routine.
External pair.sync() call inside the manual LP burn routine.
Arithmetic reduction of the transferred amount by the computed fees before final transfer.
Local swap path array in swapTokensForEth.

disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled to false permanently.
newAmount parameter flows into the swap threshold validation and assignment.

newNum parameter is scaled and written by updateMaxTxnAmount.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.

newNum parameter is scaled and written by updateMaxWalletAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
updateMaxWalletAmount reads totalSupply for the lower bound check.
updAds parameter is used as the exclusion mapping key.
isEx parameter is written into the exclusion mapping.

enabled parameter flows into updateSwapEnabled.

updateBuyFees writes buyLiquidityFee.

_liquidityFee parameter is written into sellLiquidityFee.
_devFee parameter is written into sellDevFee.
updateSellFees writes sellMarketingFee.
updateSellFees writes sellLiquidityFee.
updateSellFees writes sellDevFee.

pair parameter is passed to the internal setter and checked against uniswapV2Pair.
value parameter is forwarded to the internal setter.

pair parameter is used as the AMM mapping key.
value parameter is written into the AMM mapping.

newMarketingWallet parameter flows into updateMarketingWallet.
updateMarketingWallet writes marketingWallet.
newWallet parameter flows into updatecharityWallet.
updatecharityWallet writes charityWallet.
account parameter is used to query the fee-exclusion mapping.
isExcludedFromFees reads _isExcludedFromFees.
_frequencyInSeconds parameter is written into lpBurnFrequency.
_percent parameter is written into percentForLPBurn.
_Enabled parameter is written into lpBurnEnabled.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnFrequency.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes percentForLPBurn.
setAutoLPBurnSettings writes lpBurnEnabled.
from parameter drives transfer restrictions and balance updates.
to parameter drives AMM pair detection and wallet limit checks.

_transfer reads tradingActive to gate transfers before launch.
_transfer reads transferDelayEnabled for the anti-bot delay.
_transfer reads _holderLastTransferTimestamp to throttle bot buys.

_transfer writes the current block number under the tx.origin key.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to detect buys/sells.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFees to skip fees and limits.
_transfer reads _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount for limit exemptions.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buys and sells.
_transfer compares contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on recipient balance.
_transfer reads the swapping guard to avoid nested fee logic.
_transfer sets and clears the swapping guard around swapBack.
_transfer reads swapEnabled before triggering swapBack.
_transfer reads lpBurnEnabled before triggering the auto LP burn.
_transfer reads lpBurnFrequency for the burn schedule check.
_transfer reads lastLpBurnTime for the burn schedule check.
_transfer compares block.timestamp against the LP burn schedule, a timestamp dependency.
_transfer reads buyTotalFees to compute buy fees.
_transfer reads sellTotalFees to compute sell fees.
_transfer uses buyMarketingFee to split accrued tokens.
_transfer uses buyLiquidityFee to split accrued tokens.
_transfer uses buyDevFee to split accrued tokens.
_transfer uses sellMarketingFee to split accrued tokens.
_transfer uses sellLiquidityFee to split accrued tokens.
_transfer uses sellDevFee to split accrued tokens.
_transfer accumulates tokensForMarketing from collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForLiquidity from collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForDev from collected fees.
_transfer invokes swapBack when the swap threshold is met.
_transfer invokes autoBurnLiquidityPairTokens when the burn schedule is met.
_transfer reduces the transferred amount by the fee value.
_transfer computes contractTokenBalance.
_transfer computes the canSwap flag.
_transfer computes the takeFee flag.
_transfer computes the fees amount.
swapTokensForEth uses the immutable router address.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped.
path local array defines the token-to-WETH swap route.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap with zero slippage protection.
amountToSwapForETH computed in swapBack is passed into swapTokensForEth.
addLiquidity uses the immutable router address.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and added as liquidity.
ethAmount parameter is forwarded as the ETH value.
addLiquidity performs the external router addLiquidityETH call.
ethForLiquidity computed in swapBack is passed into addLiquidity.
swapBack reads tokensForMarketing to compute the ETH split.
swapBack reads tokensForLiquidity to compute the ETH split.
swapBack reads tokensForDev to compute the ETH split.

swapBack resets tokensForMarketing to zero after processing.
swapBack resets tokensForLiquidity to zero after processing.
swapBack resets tokensForDev to zero after processing.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth.
swapBack calls addLiquidity.
swapBack forwards ETH to charityWallet with an unchecked low-level call, enabling reentrancy.
swapBack forwards the remaining balance to marketingWallet with an unchecked low-level call, enabling reentrancy.
charityWallet is the destination of the dev/charity ETH transfer.
marketingWallet is the destination of the residual ETH transfer.
swapBack computes contractBalance.
swapBack computes totalTokensToSwap.
swapBack computes liquidityTokens.
swapBack computes amountToSwapForETH.

swapBack computes the ETH gained from the swap.
swapBack computes ethForMarketing.
swapBack computes ethForDev.
swapBack derives ethForLiquidity as the remainder.

manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens reads the pair address for balance and sync.
manualBurnLiquidityPairTokens performs an external pair.sync() call.
